blue.value: Indanthren Calidon (GCDN), a 1948 sub-committee's choice, never gazetted

laws.text: Proclamation of the Flag of the State of Israel, Provisional Council of State, 28 October 1948
Flag, Emblem and National Anthem Law, 5709-1949

meta.name: Israel
notes: The proclamation was read as the Foreign Ministry's site reproduced it. It says 'as illustrated', and the illustration wasn't seen, so the star's overall size of 66 cm is from a FOTW contributor's sheet, not the text.

The proclamation says only dark sky-blue. FOTW reports a 1948 sub-committee's choice of the dye Indanthren Calidon, never gazetted. The hex is the Album des Pavillons 2023 as FOTW reports it, which lists a darker Pantone 280 C and this lighter one. Taking the lighter for the national flag is an inference from FOTW's report that naval and police flags use a darker shade.

restrictions.text: Section 2: the State flag may not be used for commerce, business or a profession without a licence from the Minister of the Interior, though flying, making and selling flags is excepted.
